cleaner, or other environmental sources.
Clinical Manifestations
Signs and symptoms that an individual experiences will be de-
termined by the extent of the burn injury—by both depth and 
body surface area aﬀ ected. Age, nutritional status, and other 
comorbidities will have an impact on the physiological response 
to the injury, treatment, and recovery.
